    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceNeeded" targetRef="Task_TakeInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">parcel insurance is necessary</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_TakeInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
